purpose: Explicit three-image input contract for native five-part OTA assembly. Other two OS images must come from the separately qualified current native build.

inputs.copy_policy: Exact complete image bytes; no truncation, repadding, re-signing or rebuilding.

layout.note: The complete 64 MiB boot image includes the existing inner signatures and trailer, outer AVB metadata, padding and terminal footer. The original-image length is not the payload file length.

inputs.copy_policy: Exact complete image bytes; no truncation, repadding, re-signing or rebuilding.

layout.note: The complete 32 MiB partition image includes the filesystem, hashtree, FEC, signed metadata, padding and terminal footer.

inputs.copy_policy: Exact complete image bytes; no truncation, repadding, re-signing or rebuilding.

layout.note: The complete 1 MiB child image contains a 2,496-byte signed VBMeta prefix and zero padding. The prefix alone is not the admitted payload.

kernel_provenance.source_binding: Compiled source bytes were committed after successful qualification; this records source equivalence, not a post-commit rebuild.

avb_contract.note: The AVB owner key and module CMS certificate are separate identities. Qualifying the main and recovery parents remains a deployment prerequisite.

input_rules: Resolve only the three listed filenames in an explicitly supplied input directory; require size and SHA256 equality before use and after final payload reconstruction.
Do not select current build outputs by glob or recency, substitute another kernel build, or change module signatures.
Binary image inputs remain excluded from source repositories; track this portable contract and reviewed assembly source.

source_publication.status: Public source availability not established by this manifest.
source_publication.obligation: Before distribution, publish or otherwise provide the corresponding complete source, applicable patches/configuration and build information required by the licenses for this exact kernel/module cohort. Confirm availability rather than treating a local commit hash as a public source release.

scope: Static input/provenance declaration only. No firmware update, runtime behavior, performance, battery, installation or redistribution admission.
